Kageaki"The appointment is made. Very well, I shall use it."
Kageaki"But your generals are an exceptional collection."
Chachamaru"That much apun admits."
Chachamaru"Sorry, bhai."
Kageaki"And you are the worst of them."
Chachamaru"Arre, direct first prize only."
Chachamaru"But listen."
Chachamaru"Apun has work outside."
Chachamaru"Somebody must keep this place running."
Kageaki"And that somebody has been selected without consultation."
Chachamaru"You can do it."
Kageaki"That is not an answer to the objection."
Chachamaru"No, but it is the reason."
Chachamaru"Apun will make it worth your trouble."
Kageaki"I have already stated my price."
Chachamaru"Hikaru. Yes."
Chachamaru"Apun knows."
Kageaki"Then do not offer unrelated compensation."
Chachamaru"Okay, okay."
Chachamaru"So we are settled?"
Kageaki"No."
Chachamaru"Kaiko no?"
Kageaki"You appear to have mistaken the end of your explanation for the end of my demands."
Chachamaru"Bhai, even a government closes sometimes."
